data.title: ONE Championship: Itsuki Hirata finds her way back with revenge over Jihin
data.description: Four years and seven months after Jihin Radzuan handed her a first professional defeat, Itsuki Hirata finally had her revenge. After everything that followed that night in Singapore, she also had reason to believe her career was moving forward again.

data.title: Wrong anthems played at Asian Para Games after mishap-marred Asian Games
data.description: TOKYO — Wrong national anthems were played three times at the Asian Para Games in Japan's Nagoya this week, prompting the mayor to apologise just days after the city hosted the mishap-plagued Asian Games.

data.title: Man U humiliated as Arsenal deny Bayern in Champions League
data.description: Manchester United were hammered 4-1 by Como in the Champions League on Wednesday as the pressure increased on beleaguered manager Michael Carrick, while a late Declan Rice equaliser earned Arsenal a 2-2 draw away to Bayern Munich.

data.title: MotoGP riders to bid ‘emotional’ farewell to Phillip Island
data.description: PHILLIP ISLAND, Australia - Seven-time world champion Marc Marquez admits it will be “emotional” this weekend as one of MotoGP’s most iconic circuits at Phillip Island hosts its last race after nearly three decades.

data.title: Ohtani surgery 'not on the table': Dodgers chief
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday ruled out off-season surgery for Shohei Ohtani following the Japanese superstar's injury-hit end to the season.

data.title: 28 Thais set for historic Dakar event
data.description: Twenty-eight Thai athletes will compete across 11 sports at the 4th Youth Olympic Games to be held from Oct 31 to Nov 13 in Senegal.

data.title: Fatigued Kunlavut crashes out again
data.description: Kunlavut Vitidsarn suffered another early exit after losing in the men's singles first round of the US$950,000 BWF French Open in Paris on Tuesday.

data.title: Asics seeks to inspire young talent with one-day tourney
data.description: This year's edition of the popular Asics Badminton Championship has been scheduled to take place next month in Bangkok with the aim of inspiring talented young players to elevate their standards to a professional level.

data.title: Boccia aces lead 6-gold Thai haul, pump tally to 14
data.description: Thai boccia stars claimed four gold medals at the 5th Asian Para Games, while Visit Kingmanaw earned a breakthrough for the para fencing team in Aichi-Nagoya on Wednesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri floats Nabil vs Carrillo title rematch as featherweight options shift
data.description: Nabil Anane could move up to challenge Nico Carrillo for ONE Championship’s featherweight Muay Thai title, with Chatri Sityodtong floating a rematch as the Scottish champion waits for his next defence.

data.title: ONE Championship: Noiri answers Siasarani’s Muay Thai challenge – but wants kickboxing gold first
data.description: Japan’s Masaaki Noiri has left the door open to Mohammad Siasarani’s Muay Thai challenge, but says winning ONE Championship’s undisputed featherweight kickboxing title must come first.

data.title: LeBron, Sixers spoil Knicks party, Thunder top Spurs as NBA season tips off
data.description: NEW YORK - LeBron James and his new Philadelphia 76ers teammates crashed the New York Knicks' season-opening celebrations on Tuesday, beating the defending NBA champions 106-100 on the night they raised their title banner at Madison Square Garden.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rifdean apologises after Chatri rejects Nadaka rematch
data.description: Malaysian fighter Rifdean Masdor has apologised over a recent social media statement, while his management has sought to clarify its role in his preparations for ONE Samurai 4.

data.title: 'Leave us alone!' DC golfers fear worst over Trump's course remodel
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - For years, Max Salas has enjoyed teeing off at Washington's East Potomac Golf Links, a public course nestled in the heart of the US capital where ordinary Americans can enjoy a round without breaking the bank.

data.title: PSG late show downs Barca in Champions League, Liverpool fight back
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Holders Paris Saint-Germain made it three wins from three in this season's Champions League, beating Barcelona 4-2 thanks to late goals from Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz on Tuesday, while Liverpool clinched a dramatic comeback victory over Villarreal.

data.title: Regulator has 'power' to force Man City sale
data.description: LONDON - English football's Independent Regulator (IFR) will have "absolute power" to force Manchester City’s owners to sell if they are ultimately found to have run the club improperly, the watchdog’s chair has said.

data.title: Wild Brian: The game's eccentric was a howling success
data.description: I was sitting at the back of the packed Bournemouth cinema with my girlfriend watching a comedy and enjoying the cozy romantic situation until a large gentleman sat directly behind us. Then during every funny scene he let out a very loud haunting, and slightly disturbing howl of a laugh. Not only did his horrifying laugh freak out my girlfriend, but also disturbed the entire back half of the cinema. When the film finished I turned to see the familiar big frame of Brian Barnes, who was totally oblivious to ruining everybody's evening entertainment.

data.title: Thai GP ticket sales delayed
data.description: The organisers of the MotoGP Thailand Grand Prix have announced a postponement of the ticket launch for the 2027 season-opening race.

data.title: Golds pour in for Thai athletes
data.description: Thailand pushed their gold medal haul up to five at the 2026 Asian Para Games as the country's track stars put on a dazzling show in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on Tuesday.

data.title: Surging Port tie captain Peeradol to 2-year deal
data.description: Port have extended the contract of captain Peeradol Chamrasamee by two years, with the midfielder's current deal due to expire at the end of this season.
